param_input_item.param_description: a string: tar archive file name or http/https URL.
a character vector or string scalar: destination folder (default: current folder).
a nonnegative integer: largest total number of bytes the extraction may write (default: Inf, no limit).
a positive number: the extraction is refused when the total size of the files is more than maxratio times the size of the archive file (default: Inf, no limit).

param_output_item.param_description: a cell array of character vectors: names of the written files and folders.

description.p: untar extracts the content of a tar archive.
Plain archives and archives compressed with gzip, zstd, xz, bzip2, lz4 or lzma are accepted: the compression is detected from the content, not from the name.
A URL is downloaded to a temporary file first, which is deleted after extraction.

Protection against decompression bombs: MaxExtractedSize limits the total size written (error Nelson:file_archiver:extractedSizeLimit) and MaxCompressionRatio limits the total size of the files compared to the size of the compressed archive file (error Nelson:file_archiver:compressionRatioLimit). An extraction larger than the free disk space of the destination is refused (error Nelson:file_archiver:notEnoughSpace). These checks are done before anything is written.

Unsafe entry names such as '../x' are refused, and nothing is written through a symbolic link. On Linux and macOS, a symbolic link is restored only when its target stays inside the destination folder. Other symbolic links, hard links, and all links on Windows are skipped and are not in the returned names.
Dates are restored. Execute permissions of entries are kept (the umask is applied), except on Windows.
Ctrl+C stops the extraction and removes the file being written.
